decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey rear extension, by way of it's position, size, scale, appearance and rearward location, would have minimal impact on the dwelling's appearance and the character of the immediate locality and would not harm neighbours' living conditions and therefore complies with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the souther sidewall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be converted into a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
